questions.cardText:
[Geography] If a bird flies straight south from downtown Detroit, what is the first country (not including the United States) it will reach?
A. Mexico B. Cuba C. Canada
Answer: C. Due to the curvature of the Detroit River, Windsor, Ontario, is directly south of Detroit, making Canada the first foreign country a bird would reach flying south from Detroit.
questions.de: Welches fremde Land erreicht ein Vogel zuerst, wenn er von der Innenstadt Detroits aus geradewegs nach Süden fliegt – dank der Biegung des Detroit River?
questions.en: Flying straight south from downtown Detroit, which foreign country does a bird reach first, thanks to the bend of the Detroit River?

timeline.labelEn: Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac founds Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit, the origin of Detroit
timeline.labelDe: Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac gründet Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit, den Ursprung Detroits

questions.notes: Confirmed: Detroit is directly north of Windsor, Ontario (Wikipedia 'Detroit River' and 'Detroit': the only major border city where one travels south into Canada).

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What is the first meal of a monarch butterfly caterpillar?
A. Nectar from flowers
B. Eggshell
C. Milkweed fuzz
Answer: B. While the first meal of a monarch butterfly caterpillar is usually its own eggshell, its second meal can sometimes be the eggs of another monarch butterfly, displaying cannibalistic behavior.
questions.de: Was frisst eine frisch geschlüpfte Monarchfalter-Raupe meist zuerst, bevor sie mit der Seidenpflanze beginnt?
questions.en: What does a newly hatched monarch butterfly caterpillar usually eat first, before starting on milkweed?

timeline.labelEn: Carl Linnaeus first describes the monarch butterfly in Systema Naturae
timeline.labelDe: Carl Linné beschreibt den Monarchfalter erstmals in seiner Systema Naturae

questions.notes: Confirmed: 'The larva or caterpillar eats its egg case and begins to feed on milkweed' (Wikipedia).
